description.en: Pushes a camera onto the active camera stack, making it the currently rendered camera (the previous camera is restored later with CMND_POP_CAMERA).
Handle of the camera to activate.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Switch to a loaded scripted camera
CMND_PUSH_CAMERA(hCamera);
